clips.title: The story
paras: At the Warsong Lumber Camp, Logging Rope keeps the mills and machinery supplied. Furbolg tribes have stolen shipments across Ashenvale, leaving the Warsong to recover the line they need.

Logging Rope shipments meant for the Warsong Lumber Camp have been stolen. The Foulweald and Thistlefur furbolgs intercepted the line before it reached the loggers. The tribes keep the ropes in their encampments across northern and central Ashenvale. Corruption has driven the furbolgs mad, and they fiercely defend their ancestral woods.

Locke Okarr at Splintertree Post seeks to recover the stolen supplies before work at the Warsong Lumber Camp stops. The heavy rope lets the Horde secure timber, bind logs, and rig saw machinery. Furbolg resistance continues across the forest.
